description: This marks the second step of the passing of the Epstein Files Transparency Act, sending the bill to the desk of the President.
headline: U.S. Senate Passes Epstein Files Transparency Act

info.description: The Senate passed the act by unanimous consent.
info.note: That is, the bill passed without needing to hold a vote, as none objected.

info.description: House Speaker Mike Johnson expressed concern over the Senate's passing of the bill, despite voting for the bill one day prior.
info.note: Speaker Johnson stated that he spoke with the President and felt the bill needed "amendments." He did not substantially comment on whether or not he expected a Presidential veto.
